nota: Verificator adversarial H1, lentila TIMING. Toate interogarile ShopifyQL/GraphQL rulate read-only pe 2026-11-05. Orele TIMESERIES hour sunt UTC (Europe/Bucharest = UTC+3 pana la 25.10, apoi UTC+2); zilele TIMESERIES day sunt in Europe/Bucharest, deci totalurile orare pe zi UTC nu coincid exact cu cele zilnice.

magazin_cpc_google_orar_UTC.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions TIMESERIES hour SINCE 2026-10-17 UNTIL 2026-10-20 WHERE utm_source = 'google' AND utm_medium = 'cpc'
magazin_cpc_google_orar_UTC.citire: Ruptura este luni 19.10 intre 11:00 si 12:00 UTC (14:00-15:00 ora Romaniei), NU la 22:04 UTC 18.10 cand s-au scris etichetele. Dimineata de 19.10 (07-11 UTC) = 15 sesiuni, identic cu sambata 17.10 (15). Dupa-amiaza 19.10 = 4 fata de 51 (17.10) si 39 (18.10).

grup_marja-mare_exclus_9pagini_orar_UTC_.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions TIMESERIES hour SINCE 2026-10-18 UNTIL 2026-10-20 WHERE utm_campaign = 'Google Shopping' AND landing_page_path IN (9 pagini)

grup_volum_8pagini_orar_UTC_19-22.10.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions TIMESERIES hour SINCE 2026-10-19 UNTIL 2026-10-22 WHERE utm_campaign = 'Google Shopping' AND landing_page_path IN (8 pagini volum)
grup_volum_8pagini_orar_UTC_19-22.10.citire: Grupul volum s-a oprit si el la 12:00 UTC 19.10 si a repornit vizibil miercuri 21.10 de la ~14:00-16:00 UTC (17:00-19:00 ora Romaniei). Grupul marja-mare/exclus nu a repornit.

grup_marja-mare_exclus_9pagini_zilnic_17.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions TIMESERIES day SINCE 2026-08-17 UNTIL 2026-11-04 WHERE utm_campaign = 'Google Shopping' AND landing_page_path IN (9 pagini)
grup_marja-mare_exclus_9pagini_zilnic_17.citire: Nivelul 0-2/zi din 22-31.10 (6 zile cu 0 din 10) nu a aparut niciodata in cele 63 de zile dinainte (minim 2, nicio zi cu 0). Schimbare de regim, nu zgomot. Revenire partiala 01-04.11 dupa reducerile de pret din 30.10.

magazin_cpc_google_zilnic_17.08-04.11.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions TIMESERIES day SINCE 2026-08-17 UNTIL 2026-11-04 WHERE utm_source = 'google' AND utm_medium = 'cpc'
magazin_cpc_google_zilnic_17.08-04.11.citire: Saptamana 12-18.10 (438) este un varf anormal (zilnic 84-90 in 15-18.10 fata de 31-49 in 06-11.10). Nivelul de dupa (15-23/zi) este sub orice saptamana dinainte, dar cel mai apropiat de 31.08-06.09 (9-26/zi).

creapure_cpc_zilnic_21.09-18.10.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY utm_medium TIMESERIES day SINCE 2026-09-21 UNTIL 2026-10-18 WHERE referrer_source = 'search' AND referrer_name = 'google' AND landing_page_path = '/products/creatina-creapure'
creapure_cpc_zilnic_21.09-18.10.citire: Creapure cpc era deja la ~1/zi (15 sesiuni in 15 zile) in 30.09-14.10, fara nicio eticheta; a revenit 4 zile (15-18.10) odata cu varful de buget al magazinului, apoi a cazut. Media 'inainte' de 16/sapt. e umflata de aug-sept; fata de ultimele 2 saptamani dinainte (15, 6) caderea este 10 -> 3.

alte_canale_cpc_zilnic.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY utm_source TIMESERIES day SINCE 2026-10-06 UNTIL 2026-11-04 WHERE utm_medium = 'cpc'
alte_canale_cpc_zilnic.facebook: ~1/zi pana la 17.10, 47 pe 18.10 (boost de o zi), 0 din 19.10

test_eticheta_vs_categorie.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY landing_page_path TIMESERIES week SINCE 2026-08-17 UNTIL 2026-11-01 WHERE utm_source = 'google' AND utm_medium = 'cpc' AND landing_page_path IN (15 handle-uri)
test_eticheta_vs_categorie.citire: Linia marja-mare/volum coincide cu suplimente/alimente; produsele care ar separa eticheta de categorie au volume prea mici. 'exclus' a mai primit 9 clicuri in 19-25.10 -> excluderea nu a fost stricta/imediata.

organic_4pagini_fara_UTM_zilnic.citire: Nicio treapta pe 19.10 in organic; treapta este exclusiv in cpc.
